description: This file defines REST API endpoints for related data retrieval, including related fields and distinct values, within the Superset project. It extends base API classes, manages filters, pagination, and response formatting, and includes decorators for metrics and error handling.

classes.name: RelatedResultResponseSchema
classes.description: Schema for individual related result items, including id, text, and extra metadata.

classes.name: RelatedResponseSchema
classes.description: Schema for related data response, including total count and list of related items.

classes.name: DistinctResultResponseSchema
classes.description: Schema for individual distinct value items.

classes.name: DistincResponseSchema
classes.description: Schema for distinct values response, including total count and list of items.

classes.name: RelatedFieldFilter
classes.description: Data class to specify filter configuration for related endpoints.

classes.name: BaseFavoriteFilter
classes.description: Custom filter class to filter dashboards, slices, or queries based on user favorites.

classes.name: BaseSupersetApiMixin
classes.description: Mixin providing common API response handling, metrics, and error responses.

classes.name: BaseSupersetApi
classes.description: Base API class combining mixin and core API functionalities.

classes.name: BaseSupersetModelRestApi
classes.description: Extends FAB's ModelRestApi to implement Superset-specific REST API features, including related data endpoints, filtering, and response handling.

methods.name: requires_json
methods.description: Decorator to enforce JSON request format.

methods.name: requires_form_data
methods.description: Decorator to enforce multipart/form-data request format.

methods.name: statsd_metrics
methods.description: Decorator to measure and send API call metrics.

methods.name: _get_related_filter
methods.description: Constructs filters for related data queries based on configuration.

methods.name: _get_distinct_filter
methods.description: Constructs filters for distinct value queries.

methods.name: _get_text_for_model
methods.description: Retrieves display text for a model instance based on configuration.

methods.name: _get_extra_field_for_model
methods.description: Retrieves extra fields for a model instance.

methods.name: _get_result_from_rows
methods.description: Formats query result rows into response data.

methods.name: _add_extra_ids_to_result
methods.description: Fetches and adds extra items by IDs to the result set.

methods.name: info_headless
methods.description: Overrides base info endpoint to include metrics.

methods.name: get_headless
methods.description: Overrides base get endpoint to include metrics.

methods.name: get_list_headless
methods.description: Overrides base list endpoint to include metrics.

methods.name: post_headless
methods.description: Overrides base post endpoint to include metrics.

methods.name: put_headless
methods.description: Overrides base put endpoint to include metrics.

methods.name: delete_headless
methods.description: Overrides base delete endpoint to include metrics.

methods.name: related
methods.description: API endpoint to retrieve related field data with filtering and pagination.

methods.name: distinct
methods.description: API endpoint to retrieve distinct values for a field with filtering and pagination.
